question: Where can BiceLib add a combined arms group's bonus and base flag to the division designer's combined_arms_indicator_ tooltips?

addresses.name: DivisionDesigner_BuildTooltip_GroupNameCopy
addresses.comment: `call 0x401BD0` (E8 1B 67 C1 FF) in CDivisionDesigner::BuildTooltip's combined_arms_indicator_ arm: std::string::assignString(out@ECX, the group's name made by CCombinedArmsGroup_GetName, 0, -1). The group - CSubUnitDataBase::unit_groups[atoi(suffix)], 0x7EB48E..0x7EB495 - is in EDI and is read again after the call (lea ecx, [edi+8] at 0x7EB4D0); `out` is in EBX. The group's base byte (+0x24) and value (+0x28) are what UpdateDesign's base test (0x7E65CD) and light (0x7EA5E8..0x7EA628, with CTechnologyStatus +0x5C[i]) read. BiceLib's Hooks/Tooltips/CombinedArmsLine replaces this call to add the bonus and base lines under the name. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-buildertooltips.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py 0x7EB3F0: call 0x5ADE80 (CSubUnitDataBase::GetInstance), mov ecx,[eax], mov edi,[ecx+esi*4], call 0x5B1BA0 with eax = edi, push -1 / push 0 / push eax / mov ecx,ebx / call 0x401BD0 at 0x7EB4B0; 0x401BD0 is the record's std::string::assignString. Shown wrong if the five bytes at 0x7EB4B0 do not resolve to 0x401BD0, which Hooks::isCallTo checks before BiceLib writes anything, or if EDI were clobbered by the call - the arm's own use of it at 0x7EB4D0 says it is not.
